bull.b: The record backlog and strong book-to-bill indicate durable customer demand and substantial contracted work visibility. Exposure to grid modernization, data centers, large-load development and related infrastructure should support revenue execution over the next several quarters.

bull.t: Power Delivery Growth And Market Position
bull.b: Power Delivery is becoming a stronger growth engine, supported by accelerating transmission, distribution, grid modernization and data-center infrastructure demand. Sustained backlog expansion and market-share gains can improve MasTec’s scale, utilization and competitive position.

Positive operating and free cash flow provide internal funding for equipment, labor and project execution while reducing dependence on external capital. Combined with sharply lower historical leverage and management’s below-2x net-leverage target, this improves financial flexibility.

bear.b: Moderate margins leave limited protection if project costs rise, utilization weakens or execution is delayed. Although profitability has recovered, margins remain below earlier-cycle levels, so sustaining earnings growth will depend on disciplined bidding, cost control and favorable business mix.

Permitting-related delays can defer revenue, reduce crew utilization and pressure project margins even when the underlying backlog remains healthy. Continued timing uncertainty creates execution risk and may shift earnings between periods, making near-term pipeline performance less predictable.

Communications remains a structural drag on the business mix because customer capital-spending uncertainty and execution issues are weighing on revenue and profitability. Management expects a potentially flattish 2027, limiting the segment’s ability to offset pressure elsewhere.
